subject: Metadata SpeciesTag 'Species' not found in some photos but not others

messages.author: 9365e798eed43895
messages.subject: Metadata SpeciesTag 'Species' not found in some photos but not others
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to extract metadata from my camera trap photos using recordTable. My photos are organized by grid and I have been extracting data 1 grid at a time to better allow for trouble shooting. I have been successful for all but 3 of the 13 grids. On those 3 it gives me the message:  SpeciesTag 'Species' not found in image metadata tag 'Hierarchical Subject'. Skipping.  

All photos for all grids were tagged the same way in Adobe Bridge using the same Keywords list. Yet for some reason when I check the ExifTagNames the Hierarchical Subject is not listed for these 3 grids. It is listed for the grids that were successful (see attached). 
The tagging structure we used looks like:
  • Species
    • Carnivore
      • Coyote 
We only checked the box for Carnivore and Coyote but with the successful grids it was still able to read the categories above that. For the corrupted grids I tried checking the box for Species as well but when I pulled up the Hierarchical Subjects "Species" was the only thing in there.

Does anyone have an idea of what the issue could be or how I can assign Hierarchical Subjects to these images using the keywords that have already been tagged? 

Appreciate the help,
Alex

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Metadata SpeciesTag 'Species' not found in some photos but not others
parts:
Hi Alex,
this seems to be a problem with Adobe Bridge, not camtrapR. I don't know why the relavant hierarchicalSubject tag is not being written into the image metadata. Is there any difference in the way the images were handled between the folders where it works versus where it doesn't work? The error might arise if no image is tagged at a station at all.

In digiKam there is a button "Write metadata to each file", which writes all tags to the metadata again. Maybe there is an equivalent in Bridge? Or somewhere in the settings there may be an option to write metadata to the hierarchicalSubject field instead of the Subject field only?

I am sorry for not being able to help with this problem. Maybe you can ask in an Adobe forum instead?
Best,
Jürgen
